reden: Yes. The audit’s first High finding on AuctionDemo describes the exact same issue: overlapping phases at endTime due to <= / >= checks allow claimAuction and cancelBid in the same timestamp, and claimAuction refunds non-winning bids without marking status=false. This enables double refunds (and winning-bid refund via reentrancy/callback) and drains funds from the contract’s pooled balance, letting the winner get the NFT for free and/or withdraw others’ deposits. It targets the same functions (claimAuction/cancelBid/participateToAuction), the same root cause, and the same attack path; applying the proposed fixes (strict inequality for claim phase and setting status=false before refunds) would resolve both.
